name: Choose a Monk School
text: Each School of Monk, despite having the same root of origin, evolved and developed into many school with diverse techniques and weapon used. Choosing a Monk School give you access to their passed down techniques, skills, and abilities.

uniques: Gain a free [Flowing River School] [in capital] <hidden from users>
Comment [Like the river, they flow with enemy’s attack, and use it against them, countering with crushing strike and turning the tide of battle.]
Gain a free [Open Hand School] [in capital] <hidden from users>
Comment [Using open fist and chop attacks, they disrupt and weaken enemies, sabotaging them in battle.]
Gain a free [Shadow Fang School] [in capital] <hidden from users>
Comment [Trained for infiltration and ambush, they strike from the shadows, striking confusion and crippling their enemies before they can react.]
Gain a free [White Lotus School] [in capital] <hidden from users>
Comment [Masters of elemental Qi, they channel Qi through their techniques to unleash powerful elemental attacks.]
Only available <if [Brewery] is constructed>
Gain a free [Drunken Fist School] [in capital] <hidden from users>
Comment [Unpredictable and hard to pin down, they rely on erratic movements, chance-based effects, and of course, intoxication.]
Only available <after discovering [Military Engineering]>
Gain a free [Gun Fu School] [in capital] <hidden from users>
Comment [These monks use pistols as part of their combat form, blending tradition with invention to attack enemy from afar.]
Only available <with [Wine]>
Gain a free [Loyal Brotherhood School] [in capital] <hidden from users>
Comment [These monks never fight alone—bound by oath and vengeance, they appear in pairs and grow stronger together in battle.]
Only available <when above [10] [Horses]>
Gain a free [Wuxia School] [in capital] <hidden from users>
Comment [Wuxia monks are mounted martial heroes who strike fast and ride far, trained for open warfare and charging attack.]
